name: eufemia-mcp-lambda
description: Eufemia MCP server for AWS Lambda

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && yarn workspace @dnb/eufemia build:docs && esbuild src/transports/lambda-handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/lambda-handler.mjs '--external:@aws-sdk/*' && esbuild src/usage-consumer.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/usage-consumer.mjs '--external:@aws-sdk/*' && mkdir -p dist/docs && cp -R ../../packages/dnb-eufemia/build/docs/. dist/docs && cd dist && zip -rq lambda.zip lambda-handler.mjs docs && zip -q usage-consumer.zip usage-consumer.mjs
scripts.lint: cd ../.. && node node_modules/.bin/eslint --config tools/mcp-lambda/eslint.config.mjs 'tools/{mcp-lambda/src,monitoring}/**/*.ts' && node node_modules/.bin/prettier --check 'tools/{mcp-lambda/src,monitoring}/**/*.ts' '.github/workflows/mcp-health.yml'
scripts.deploy: yarn build && terraform -chdir=infra init && terraform -chdir=infra apply -auto-approve
scripts.deploy:plan: yarn build && terraform -chdir=infra init && terraform -chdir=infra plan
